adamrk opened PR #14427 from adamrk:abk/explorer-highlight-long-lines to bytecodealliance:main:

Previously the color highlighting of a line would only extend to the width of the window. So if the line was longer you could scroll over to read the rest of it, but it could be hard to read without the background highlight. This change should make the highlighting extend to the width of the text.
